experimentGoal: Discover multiple independent viable human visual families, not ten recolors. Keep animation reusable across styles.
artTarget: As convincing as a carefully art-directed commercial stylized game character; comparison target, not guarantee or unauthorized GTA asset use.

strategies.description: Original character authored in Blender with custom face topology, UV and hand-painted/PBR details, rig afterwards
strategies.limitation: Blender executable and real render/GLB inspection required; not automatically available
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: MPFB parametric adult base, individually changed body morphs and outfit meshes, with rig+material variants validated from bytes
strategies.limitation: Generated humans alone are not guaranteed artistic quality; verify authoring tool, asset license and variety
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Unique source-modeled civilian mesh + UV atlas, then Adobe Mixamo auto-rig and clip only if account/licensing permits
strategies.limitation: Requires user-authenticated Adobe ID if Mixamo used; no account or remote action assumed; skip to other legal route if unavailable
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Take legal modular base geometry but rebuild face/hair/proportions and clothing topology, not just palette
strategies.limitation: Cannot use earlier civilian blue/granate unchanged or call a recolor new character; inspect pack license and clips
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Purpose-built dramatic actor pair with distinct faces and shape keys, gaze, blink, speech pose and hand acting
strategies.limitation: Full-face action not proven by a standard GLB or spoken subtitles; require front/profile/3-4 captures
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Create new fully authored avatar in VRoid/VRM with hair, face expressions and original clothing, load with three-vrm
strategies.limitation: Stylistic fit with submarine and GTA-inspired goal must be visually assessed. VRM != GLB directly in standard GLTF loader. License individual parts.
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Select multiple independently sourced legally compatible humanoid bases, build silhouette/face/wardrobe differentiation and retarget motions
strategies.limitation: No 12 recolors of the same CesiumMan. Verify exact source, rights, geometry differences, skeleton mapping and 2+ consumers.
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Legally sourced KayKit character with actively authored new topology/face UV and dedicated KayKit animation comparison
strategies.limitation: Free CC0 packs may remain too toy-like. Unassigned independent lab, not reason to insert a human into ventilator/clock/arcade scenes.
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Hand-authored faceted character mesh with deliberate proportions and drawn UV texture atlas in Blockbench; export and rig with compatible editor
strategies.limitation: Distinct from primitive sphere humans, but style may not match GTA-level look. Unassigned independent lab.
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

strategies.description: Full multi-view authored character atlas rendered from an actual source mesh with rig-driven animated legs/hands and billboards as LOD
strategies.limitation: Only for distant extras and fixed-angle camera; not valid as a rotatable closeup. Unassigned independent lab.
requirements: real neutral visual evidence before art approval

assignmentPolicy: NON_BINDING_HYPOTHESES_ONLY; each scene researches and authors a new appropriate character. No predetermined route or model.
projectBriefPolicy: Do not alter human brief hashes when testing flow 2.1; visual technique comes solely from universal method.
researchDisclaimer: Official docs confirm general technology exists; none of the listed pipelines is installed or artistically tested merely by inclusion in this JSON. 10 diverse strategies are experimental hypotheses, not 10 obtained models.
